Amr Moussa, Secretary-General of the Arab League from 2001 to 2011, sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar from the Arab Creativity Union in Egypt, which Mishary Alafasy received on 25 October 2008 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mishari_bin_Rashid_Alafasy)). The shared team note that it happened after 2016 under Ahmed Aboul Gheit conflicts with that date and cites no source, so I have not adopted it. The Wikipedia article is the only source I could confirm, so I have not checked it against a second one.

CONFIDENCE: 80
